[IRET.16.3] **Schema descriptors are not carried here.** Schema name,
slot descriptors (name, type, tolerance, flags), scope, and default TTL
arrive via the SCHEMA atom family (`SchemaTtl`/`SchemaLogical`/`Slot`/`SchemaDef`/`SchemaSource`) and
register into the rete schema reg (`dsc/loader.c::dsc_register_rete_schemas`)
before the `AlphaNode`/`BetaNode`/`TerminalNode` atoms load.
